inputs.name: ChEMBL
inputs.sha256_scope: roll-up: sha256 over the sorted sha256 digests of every cached reply body this build read from this API. A public API has no single byte stream to hash; this value is reproducible from the cache and changes when any reply changes.
inputs.known_gap: this API states no release or version in its replies, so the field is null rather than a date copied from the run.

inputs.sha256_scope: roll-up: sha256 over the sorted sha256 digests of every cached reply body this build read from this API. A public API has no single byte stream to hash; this value is reproducible from the cache and changes when any reply changes.

sources.genomic: the target gene only (BUB1B, from the child's two alleles, entry 083); no patient value or position
sources.clinical: not used by this table; the entry cross-references the 8 HPO terms

clinical_framing: research exercise; no row advises for or against giving any drug to any patient
limitations: cancer cell lines, one dose and one time point (Mitchell), 9 drugs (deep sets); protein level, not BubR1 function or stability; a regression on one score removes only what that score captures

columns.hit: z ≥ cut and raw log2 FC > 0
columns.breadth: share of all proteins that are hits under the same perturbation
columns.sensitivity_z: z with the SAC/kinetochore module removed from the score
